scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy ios
scripts.mobile:run: npm run build && npx cap run ios
scripts.mobile:release:check: npm run test:all && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run mobile:sync && node scripts/test-ios-release-readiness.mjs
scripts.mobile:release:simulator: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.mobile:release:archive: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/JacketChecker.xcarchive archive
scripts.test:security: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:env && npm run security:audit && npm run security:schema && npm run security:functions
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:recommendations && npm run test:phase10 && npm run test:phase11 && npm run test:phase12 && npm run test:phase13 && npm run test:phase14 && npm run test:password-security && npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run build
scripts.test:predeploy: npm run test:all && npm run test:production-config && npm run test:production-build && npm run test:e2e
